responsibility: Is the code generator and validator for the Arm CPU/architecture/FPU description database in arm-cpus.in. Depending on its cmd argument it parses that declarative source and emits C headers, option tables, ISA bit definitions, machine-description fragments, shared driver/compiler data tables, native CPU-detection tables, or validity checks for -mcpu/-mtune/-march/-mfpu names, making it the central generator that turns Arm CPU metadata into backend and driver source artifacts.
